Maya: Quick design sync 1: prototype shows toasts stealing focus on dismiss. When you close with keyboard you get a weird focus flash onto the primary button. Link: https://figma.com/file/xyz Kevin: We should never reassign focus on toast dismiss unless the user asked for it. Best practice: keep toasts out of document flow (portal) and announce via ARIA. Ria: +1. Use role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true". Avoid programmatic focus. Example:
Saved
David: Also noticed global Esc handler closes toasts AND modals. In the demo the modal closed mid-flow when someone hit Esc to dismiss a toast awkward. Maya: Proposal: register Esc on the toast element only and stopPropagation, or check that document.activeElement is inside the toast before closing. For pointer users allow click to dismiss. Kevin: I'll implement: 1) portal container top-right, 2) live region role=status, 3) no autofocus on dismiss, 4) scoped Esc handling, 5) respect prefers-reduced-motion. PR by EOD. Ria: Copy/timing: non-actionable toasts = 4s. Actionable toasts (Retry, Undo) = persistent or 8s. Error toasts should be persistent until dismissed. Keep copy terse: "Saved", "Copied", "Upload failed Retry". Maya: I'll add both timing variants and a persistent state to the Figma frames. Also will include a note about not shifting layout (absolute positioning). design-bot: preview deployed: https://deploy.preview/abc shows portal + reduced motion flag Ria: I'll post a short a11y QA checklist tomorrow (NVDA/VoiceOver steps). :white_check_mark:
